annotations.text:
Two screens, both working. Desktop: a load opens as a card, a cartridge header opens its spec card as a slide-over, Log this load and the Load log are pop-ups. Installed app: the same things as bottom sheets, the spec card pushes in from the right like any app screen, My bench is a sheet behind the top button.

White Winkel tokens; the app screen uses the real shell: 54px push header with back arrow, 62px tab bar with the raised Sell button.

Rows are consolidated: one per cartridge + bullet + weight + type + powder, lowest start, highest max, COAL alongside the max. Every figure is a real row from the data folder. Nothing on screen says where a number came from.

Try: turn Varget off, add Hybrid 100V, open the W760 load (COAL flag), log a load and change its charge above the max.

On the phone: tap a dimension line or a table row on the spec card to link them (no hover). Escape or the backdrop closes the top sheet. No fake status bar or keyboard is drawn; the real ones sit over this.
